name: Jina AI
tagline: Search-foundation APIs — Reader, embeddings, and reranker — for grounding LLMs.
description: A suite of search-foundation APIs for retrieval and RAG: a Reader that turns any URL or web search into LLM-ready markdown, multilingual multimodal embeddings, and a reranker. One key spans every service, the Reader is open source, and the embedding models are also released as open weights for self-hosting.
